resource_model.volume: fresh unpredictable cal-source8-probe-<16 hex> local named volume with exact probe labels; created absent and daemon-inspected before use
resource_model.keeper: created but never started container with read-only volume reference, preserving normal daemon volume identity until cleanup
resource_model.initializer: single root container with CAP_CHOWN only; creates root-owned public token and UID/GID 20001 mode-0700 instances plus slot lock; exits before writer
resource_model.writer: one UID/GID 20001 container, read-only image root, network none, no capabilities or privilege escalation, exact named volume read-write at /lab, no host bind or Docker socket
resource_model.attackers: separate UID/GID 20001 containers with either read-only volume or no volume, plus an explicit post-writer read-write mount counterexample
resource_model.auditor: UID/GID 20001 read-only named-volume mount; verifies only the synthetic marker, lock, family payload and counterexample directory before resource cleanup

one_shot_contract: random run/volume/container names, checked absent before creation; exact labeled volume and attached container inspected; marker token and volume dev/inode bound; one instance name under held instances descriptor; exclusive flock held from pre-mkdir through final witness; no retry of a consumed name
protected_input_separation: Only fixed synthetic public-probe JSON and random nonsecret identifiers enter containers. Runner reads candidate scripts/manifest and Docker metadata only. No original/renewed Source8 archive, issuer, reader/mapper grant, credential, private Context input or host source directory is mounted or read.
host_effect_envelope: Docker daemon creates labeled volume, keeper/writer/short-lived containers, metadata, logs, overlay state and volume files under daemon storage. Normal successful path verifies exact synthetic inventory, removes owned containers/volume, then checks daemon absence. Persistent daemon logs/cache/journal/atime are not asserted absent. Failed or unknown inventory retains labeled synthetic resources for inspection instead of deleting unrecognized state.
proof_ceiling: Demonstrates the selected daemon/volume/namespace mechanics and same-UID denial only to a container without a read-write volume mount. A Docker-capable client can create another read-write mount and same-UID writes succeed; Docker local volumes alone are not a global single-writer primitive. Daemon/admin control, host UID mapping, historical a/b slot release, protected current Source8 authorities, T35 source path contract and T02/G01/G02 remain unqualified.
